info.title: ROIC API
info.description: The ROIC API reference for v3 (`/v3.0.0`) and legacy v2 (`/v2`). In v3, Bearer authentication is recommended because it keeps credentials out of URLs. For browser testing, you may instead pass your key as the `apikey` query parameter. Use exactly one authentication method per request, never both. v2 takes the key only as the `apikey` query parameter.

regular.description: Regular trading periods effective from this date. Times use the exchange's `timezone` and 24-hour `[first-day;]HHMM-HHMM[:days]` format. For example, `1000-1500:23456` means 10:00–15:00 Monday–Friday. Day digits run from `1` = Sunday through `7` = Saturday. A leading first-day value sets the start of the trading week: `1;0930-1300:12345` means the week starts Sunday and the session runs 09:30–13:00 Sunday–Thursday. Separate array values represent multiple daily periods.

extended.description: Extended trading periods effective from this date. Times use the exchange's `timezone` and 24-hour `[first-day;]HHMM-HHMM[:days]` format. For example, `1000-1500:23456` means 10:00–15:00 Monday–Friday. Day digits run from `1` = Sunday through `7` = Saturday. A leading first-day value sets the start of the trading week: `1;0930-1300:12345` means the week starts Sunday and the session runs 09:30–13:00 Sunday–Thursday. Separate array values represent multiple daily periods.
